newsitem.title: POLAND: POLAND TO FIND BANK HANDLOWY ADVISER WITHIN MONTH.
newsitem.headline: POLAND TO FIND BANK HANDLOWY ADVISER WITHIN MONTH.

text.p: The Polish Finance Ministry will find an adviser to help appraise soon-to-be- privatised Bank Handlowy SA within a month, a senior ministry official said on Wednesday.
"We are in the final stages (of choosing the adviser). We should finish the matter within a month," Wieslaw Federowicz, director of the ministry's banking department, told Reuters.

Handlowy, Poland's largest commercial bank, is earmarked for privatisation this year with about 30 percent of shares going to international financial institutions and another 30 percent set aside for an initial public offering in June.
Handlowy has secured its own privatisation adviser, British investment bank Schroders, but the ministry also seeks a consultant to appraise the Polish bank.
Federowicz said that by the end of March it would be clear whether the sale to the institutional investor would take place before or after Handlowy's June IPO.
